name: from_raw_parts
declaration: const unsafe fn from_raw_parts < 'a , T > (data : * const T , len : usize) -> & 'a [T]
rules: For from_raw_parts, data must be non-null, even for zero-length slices or slices of zero-sized types.
For from_raw_parts, data must be properly aligned, even for zero-length slices or slices of zero-sized types.
For from_raw_parts, data must be valid for reads of len multiplied by the size of T bytes.
For from_raw_parts, the entire memory range of the slice must be contained within a single allocated object.
For from_raw_parts, data must point to len consecutive, properly initialized values of type T.
For from_raw_parts, the memory referenced by the returned slice must not be mutated for the duration of lifetime 'a, except inside an UnsafeCell.
For from_raw_parts, the total slice size, len multiplied by the size of T, must not exceed isize::MAX.
For from_raw_parts, adding the total slice size to data must not wrap around the address space.
For the example sum_slice function, if ptr is not null, it must be correctly aligned.
For the example sum_slice function, if ptr is not null, it must point to len initialized items of type f32.
